measured_or_user_supplied.bracing: User: cross triangles in the middle for the lift; interpreted as rear-plane diagonals and carriage gussets

assumptions: Both arms share one moving carriage; this remains an editable layout choice.
All dimensions other than frame height and width are photographic/layout estimates.
Triangular supports are placed behind the moving carriage; exact brace endpoints are unmeasured.
The frame is anchored to the world. Freestanding tipping, structural flexure and payload rating are unvalidated.
Lift dynamics use a finite-force linear actuator prior, not a measured belt, gearbox or motor model.
One existing dynamic strawberry specimen is transplanted to one angled pocket; growth at that angle is not calibrated.
SO-101 stock jaws are retained. YAM harvest-tool interfaces and trained policies are not transferred to SO-101.
